title: Musical father, Irish mother and French ancestry
summary: His father was a concert pianist and his mother played accordion; the family is French on his father's side and a relation, Renee Spanier, wrote a book.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
